name: com.maxkratt.nucleus.steamworksnet
description: Steam Networking Sockets transport for the Nucleus netcode engine, built on Steamworks.NET. Requires Nucleus 0.5.0 or later in Assets/Nucleus and Steamworks.NET (com.rlabrecque.steamworks.net) added by git URL.

samples.description: Steam bootstrap, name tags and the sample skin. Every other sample needs it.
Host or join by SteamID and move a capsule.
Create, join and leave Steam lobbies, with members, friends and lobby data.
Search public lobbies by distance and estimated ping.
A Steam game server with a LAN and internet server browser.
Push to talk Steam voice relayed through the server.
Kick, ban and blacklist players by SteamID, and tell a refused client why.
One button matchmaking through invisible Steam lobbies, then a members only session.
